routine.headline: Issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them.
routine.subject: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
routine.summary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.

routine.name: RateGain Travel Tech
routine.headline: Announced that Uzbekistan Airways has selected AirGain, its competitive fare intelligence platform.
routine.subject: Rategain Travel Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on  Uzbekistan Airways Selects RateGain to Strengthen Pricing Agility AcrossIts Expanding International Network "".
routine.summary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited announced that Uzbekistan Airways has selected AirGain, its competitive fare intelligence platform. The partnership aims to strengthen pricing agility across the airline's expanding international network. AirGain will provide real-time visibility of competitor fares to support revenue management decisions. Uzbekistan Airways carried 6.6 million passengers in 2025 and operates a fleet of 47 aircraft. The carrier plans to double its fleet by 2030. RateGain stated that AirGain users have reported up to 80% faster access to insights and a 1.5% increase in direct bookings. This agreement follows a competitive tender process. The announcement was filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 12, 2026.

routine.name: Infosys
routine.headline: Issued a press release on November 12, 2026, announcing that the Infosys Science Foundation awarded the Infosys Prize 2026 to six researchers.
routine.subject: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Six Promising Researchers Win the Infosys Prize 2026 Awarded by the Infosys Science Foundation'.
routine.summary: Infosys Limited issued a press release on November 12, 2026, announcing that the Infosys Science Foundation awarded the Infosys Prize 2026 to six researchers. The laureates are Karthik Sastry in Economics, Swarun Kumar in Engineering and Computer Science, Gautam Bhatia in Humanities and Social Sciences, Isha Jain in Life Sciences, Riddhipratim Basu in Mathematical Sciences, and Manoj Kumar Joshi in Physical Sciences. Each winner receives a gold medal, a citation, and a prize purse of USD 100,000. The prize honors researchers under the age of 40. The winners were selected by an international panel of jurors and announced by the trustees of the Infosys Science Foundation. The information is hosted on the company website at www.infosys.com.

routine.headline: Opened a Qualified Institutions Placement on November 11, 2026.
routine.subject: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of QIP 2026 - Special Committee meeting
routine.summary: Bajaj Finance Limited opened a Qualified Institutions Placement on November 11, 2026. The Board approved the issue following shareholder approval via special resolution on November 2, 2026. The floor price is set at Rs. 992.25 per equity share. This price is based on the relevant date of November 11, 2026. The company may offer a discount of up to 5% on this floor price. The final issue price will be determined by the company in consultation with book running lead managers. A preliminary placement document dated November 11, 2026, was approved. This document and application forms are being sent to eligible qualified institutional buyers. The QIP Committee meeting concluded at 4.30 p.m. on November 11, 2026. The preliminary placement document will be filed with the BSE and NSE on November 11, 2026.

routine.name: Maruti Suzuki
routine.headline: Filed a reference to the Financial Results for the first six months of FY 2026 issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation in Japan on 10th November 2026.
routine.subject: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Reference to the Financial Results issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation
routine.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited filed a reference to the Financial Results for the first six months of FY 2026 issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation in Japan on 10th November 2026. Suzuki Motor Corporation reported consolidated revenue of 1,466.5 billion yen for the period, an increase of 16.8 percent year-on-year. Operating profit was 134.3 billion yen, a decrease of 0.6 percent. Profit before tax stood at 156.5 billion yen, down 24.5 percent. Profit attributable to owners of parent was 90.8 billion yen, a decline of 22.8 percent. The company noted increased revenue but decreased profit. Foreign exchange rates and raw material prices were cited as external factors affecting results. Capital expenditures were 87.3 billion yen. Interest-bearing debt balance was 736.0 billion yen. Cash balance was 930.0 billion yen. The filing was submitted by Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary.

routine.name: Kaynes Technology
routine.headline: Filed Monitoring Agency Reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from two Qualified Institutional Place…
routine.subject: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended 30 September 2026
routine.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited filed Monitoring Agency Reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from two Qualified Institutional Placements. The first QIP was allotted on December 21, 2023, with ICRA Limited as the monitoring agency. The second QIP was allotted on June 24, 2025, with CRISIL Ratings Limited as the monitoring agency. ICRA reported no material deviation in the utilization of proceeds for the December 2023 issue, which raised INR 1374.000 Crore. Funds were utilized for the OSAT Facility, PCB Facility, and general corporate purposes. The PCB Facility was completed in March 2026, and general corporate purposes were completed in June 2025. The OSAT Facility is on schedule for FY24 to FY27. CRISIL Ratings Limited submitted a similar report for the June 2025 issue.

routine.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited confirms there were no deviations or variations in the utilisation of proceeds from its Qualified Institutional Placements during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The first Qualified Institutional Placement was allotted on 21 December 2023 with ICRA Limited as the monitoring agency. The second Qualified Institutional Placement was allotted on 24 June 2025 with CRISIL Ratings Limited as the monitoring agency. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee through a circular resolution dated November 06, 2026. The Board of Directors reviewed the statement through a circular resolution dated November 08, 2026. This information is available on the company website at www.kaynestechnology.co.in.

routine.name: Bajaj Finance
routine.headline: Approved the preferential allotment of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited.
routine.subject: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 5,74,25,740 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on November 10, 2026
routine.summary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved the preferential allotment of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The allotment was approved by the PI 2026 Allotment Committee on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is priced at Rs. 1,010 and is convertible into one equity share of face value Re. 1. The warrants are convertible into equity shares pari passu with existing fully paid-up shares. Upon issuance, a minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable on the date of allotment. The remaining 75 percent is payable when the options against the warrants are exercised. If the allottee does not exercise the option within eighteen months from the date of allotment, the consideration amount shall be forfeited by the company.
